annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, and exact finite-certificate strengthening of Theorem 3.3

assumptions: Computed exponential terms are nonnegative and satisfy a uniform componentwise relative error bound.
The final division has a bounded relative error with a nonnegative radius.
Gamma is valid through n and the exact denominator radius is strictly less than one.
Overflow and underflow are outside the finite certificate, matching the theorem's source assumptions.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p14_t2_basic_softmax_component_error {n : Nat} (fp : StandardAddModel) (x wHat : Fin n -> Real) (j : Fin n) ... : relativeError computedSoftmax exactSoftmax <= (numeratorRadius+denominatorRadius)/(1-denominatorRadius)
formal_statement.plain_language: Componentwise exponential and division errors, combined with recursive summation, give an exact finite relative-error bound for every basic softmax component.

informal_proof: Bound the perturbed numerator, combine the componentwise exponential errors with the recursive-summation error for the denominator, prove the computed denominator remains nonzero, and apply an exact quotient perturbation inequality.
informal_statement: Exact finite componentwise counterpart of Theorem 3.3; setting both operation radii to u recovers the first-order coefficient n+3.
